verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents an official MP CLI that operates payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports with a single token, 'without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls'. That is first-party headless, token-authenticated automation. Its MCP server also supports creating test users and managing their funds to validate payment flows programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage documentation (e.g., pipeline examples, non-interactive/env-var auth guidance), depth beyond a single overview line, independent or hands-on corroboration.
